name: blindness/deafness
lore:
### On the Severing of Senses: Blindness/Deafness

To master *Blindness/Deafness* is to manipulate the very conduits of perception. When shaping this spell, the practitioner feels the Weave turn viscous and frigid, like grasping a handful of freezing mud. It is a parasitic magic, requiring a sharp, decisive tug to sever the subject’s connection to the material world.

Visually, the magic manifests as a swirl of oily, iridescent vapor that rushes toward the victim’s face. For blindness, the shadow settles over the pupils like an impenetrable shroud of ink; for deafness, it appears as a shimmering, crystalline distortion that vibrates briefly before collapsing into a suffocating void.

Legend claims the spell was birthed by the Archmage Valerius the Spiteful. Weary of the incessant mocking of a rival’s familiar, Valerius crafted the incantation to ensure his studies remained undisturbed. He sought not just silence, but the absolute command over another's reality. Adventurers, heed my warning: to cast this is to invite a permanent chill into your own spirit, for the theft of another’s senses leaves a lingering stain upon the weaver’s soul.
